# Le Petit Paradis

> بوتيك أزياء أطفال فاخرة في السعودية — فساتين، أحذية، وهدايا للرضّع والبنات والأولاد، مع توصيل داخل المملكة ودول الخليج.
> Le Petit Paradis is a luxury children's fashion boutique in Saudi Arabia, offering dresses, shoes and gifts for babies, girls and boys, with delivery across the GCC.

## Pages

- [الرئيسية / Home](/): Featured collections and new arrivals.
- [بحث / Search](/search): Search the full catalog.
- [قصتنا / Our Story](/our-story): About the boutique and its story.
- [الشحن والتوصيل / Shipping](/shipping): Delivery options, times and fees.
- [الأسئلة الشائعة / Help](/help): Frequently asked questions and support.
- [تواصل معنا / Contact](/contact): Ways to reach the boutique.
- [تتبع الطلب / Track order](/track-order): Check an order's delivery status.
- [الخصوصية / Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Optional

- [الفساتين / Dresses](/category/dresses): Girls' dresses collection.
- [الأحذية / Shoes](/category/shoes): Children's shoes collection.
- [الهدايا / Gifts](/category/gifts): Gift sets for newborns and children.
